[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].Description
Maximum decentralization: Monolith is a faction that serves as the O-Consciousness' shield. Its primary goal is to protect the Zone from any external interference. It is extremely hostile to all other factions. Despite its superior weaponry, it has difficulty controlling its territory, as it is located in the northern part of the Zone.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Maximum decentralization: Find and eradicate!

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Maximum decentralization: The Monolith has commanded us to make peace with you. Do you agree or not?

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
Maximum decentralization: It is in vain that you do not follow the will of the Monolith.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes

Maximum decentralization: Victory! The government took control of the Zone, and as soon as it reviewed the documents from the laboratories, it decided to immediately classify everything. Eliminating the anomalous manifestations of the Zone is the new government order that must be carried out.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! The government took control of the Zone. But corruption and neglect flourished. For some reason, there wasn't enough ammunition for raids against mutants, either because it was unusable or because the necessary supplies were out of stock. The perimeter guards weren't guarding, but rather collecting bribes to transport prohibited items, like artifacts. It's unclear what this lack of attention to the Zone will lead to, but it's unlikely to be anything good.

[Rules.Rule-1].Name: [Groups.soldiers.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Maximum decentralization: Victory! Government forces had taken control of the entire exclusion zone and were now rapidly restoring order. Ensuring the safety of research teams became a new priority. Various small units of special forces soldiers were formed for operations in particularly dangerous conditions. This was the name given to the underground complexes and laboratories, which, to the generals' surprise, turned out to be several times larger than initially anticipated. All information obtained was quickly classified, and the public knew only what the government told them about the Zone.
